summary_text: Clinical-stage biotech (no revenue/earnings driver). Catalysts are clinical/regulatory, not earnings. ORKA-001 interim Phase 2 showed 63.5% PASI 100 at week 16, surpassing other IL-23 inhibitors. Company guides to a clinical catalyst every ~6 months for ORKA-001 and ORKA-002. Recently completed an upsized ~US$700M offering after the Apr 27 data - post-offering share supply is a near-term overhang/swing factor. Analysts call 2026 a catalyst-rich year. No traditional earnings date functions as the catalyst; story is future-potential driven with heavy R&D spend and operating losses.
